reading_note: The arc moves from the daily phenomenon of sunrise and sunset, read as two mysteries, into a double spiritual reading: the rising of the sun corresponds to the first advent of Divine Truth (the First Man) which scatters the sons of darkness and initiates the great combat against falsities from evil; the setting corresponds to the final consummation, when all light has been purified and gathered, evil is shut up in its own night, and the Lord as the Sun stands as the Illuminator in the heavens. The teaching shows how every day in the natural sun externally pictures the whole spiritual history of redemption — first advent and last judgment — held forth continuously to those who can see.
